# Manteision

*Y prif fanteision i sefydliad, fesul maes.*

## Gwelededd portffolio

Yn aml, cedwir gwybodaeth portffolio mewn sawl lle. Yn y feddalwedd hon, un math o gofnod yw pob portffolio, rhaglen, prosiect a chynnyrch, sef **cynllun**. Gall unrhyw gynllun gynnwys unrhyw un arall, i unrhyw ddyfnder, felly gall y strwythur gyd-fynd â'r sefydliad. Mae label fel "Prosiect" yn ddisgrifiadol ac nid yw'n gosod unrhyw gyfyngiad ar gynllun.

## Lleihau dyblygu

Gall dwy adran siartio'r un fenter dan enwau gwahanol. Mae'r paru'n cymharu'r priodoleddau sy'n adnabod cynllun: enw, nodau, perchennog, noddwr, rhiant, amserlen, geiriau allweddol a dynodwyr. Mae'n gweithio ar draws pob math o gynllun ac yn dangos y dystiolaeth ar gyfer pob paru, a pherson sy'n gwneud y penderfyniad. Gellir cyfuno dau gofnod o un cynllun.

## Ansawdd adrodd

- Dangosir ffigur coll gyda rheswm, er enghraifft "dim rhagolwg, oherwydd…".
- Dangosir cynllun heb asesiad fel "heb ei asesu".
- Dangosir hyder cyflawni a gofnodwyd gan bobl wrth ymyl y statws a gyfrifir, a chedwir y ddau ar wahân.
- Mae cynlluniau preifat wedi'u heithrio o bob cyfanswm a chyfrif i bob defnyddiwr. Mae profion yn gwirio'r rheol hon.
- Mae pob hyd yn nodi a yw mewn dyddiau calendr neu ddyddiau busnes.

## Cofnodion penderfyniadau

Caiff pob newid ei archwilio, ac ni ellir newid y trywydd archwilio drwy'r gwasanaeth. Ni all y sawl sy'n codi cais am newid ei gymeradwyo. Caiff pecyn misol i gyfarwyddwyr ei ddrafftio unwaith, ei gyhoeddi gan berson a enwir ac yna ei rewi gan y gronfa ddata. Cyhoeddir cywiriad fel fersiwn newydd gyda nodyn.

## Diogelwch

Mae mewngofnodi ymlaen yn ddiofyn, ac nid yw'r gwasanaeth yn cychwyn wrth gynhyrchu gyda mewngofnodi wedi'i ddiffodd. Mae penawdau diogelwch, cyfyngu cyfradd, cynllun adfer gyda thargedau wedi'u nodi a phecyn llywodraethu gwybodaeth wedi'u cynnwys yn yr ystorfa.

## Rheolaeth a chludadwyedd

- **Trwyddedu.** Mae'r feddalwedd yn god agored, dan ddewis o MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, GPL-2.0 neu GPL-3.0.
- **Lletya.** Mae'r feddalwedd yn cael ei hunan-letya: un gwasanaeth Rust dros PostgreSQL, gyda rhyngwyneb SvelteKit.
- **Mewnforio data.** Gellir mewnforio ffeiliau CSV o Jira ac Asana, gyda rhagolwg a rheswm wedi'i nodi am unrhyw beth a eithrir. Gellir mewnforio ac allforio XML Microsoft Project.
- **Ieithoedd.** Mae'r rhyngwyneb ar gael mewn deg locale, gan gynnwys Arabeg o'r dde i'r chwith. Drafftiau yw'r cyfieithiadau, sy'n aros am adolygiad gan siaradwyr.

## Tudalennau cysylltiedig

Gweler hefyd y [nodweddion](../nodweddion/index.md), y [cymariaethau](../cymariaethau/index.md) a'r [tiwtorial](../tiwtorial/index.md).

# Nodweddion

*Crynodeb swyddogaethol fesul maes. Mae'r gofrestr a'r man gwaith prosiect yn rhannu un cofnod.*

## Cynlluniau a pharu

- Un casgliad ailadroddus o gynlluniau, gyda label dewisol fel Portffolio, Rhaglen neu Brosiect
- Paru dyblygu esboniadwy ar draws pob math o gynllun
- Cyfuno dau gofnod o un cynllun yn un cofnod

## Gwaith bob dydd

- Tudalen bersonol "Fy ngwaith" a bwrdd kanban personol
- Byrddau tasgau, calendrau a cherrig milltir
- Golygon wedi'u cadw, a chwilio ar draws y portffolio

## Amserlennu

- Siartiau Gantt a strwythur dadansoddiad gwaith
- Llwybr critigol, gyda'r wyth math o gyfyngiad Microsoft Project
- Llinellau sylfaen, iechyd amserlen a lefelu adnoddau
- Cadwyn gritigol, gyda byfferau, rheoli byfferau a'r drwm

## Arian

- Llinellau cyllideb, costau a chyfriflyfr cyllid
- Gwerth a enillwyd
- Risg cost, a risg cost ac amserlen gyda'i gilydd

## Pobl a chapasiti

- Adnoddau, rolau, cronfeydd sgiliau ac argaeledd
- Map gwres capasiti ac ymrwymiadau capasiti
- Pobl allweddol

## Strategaeth a derbyn gwaith

- Derbyn gwaith, gyda chynigion a syniadau
- Amcanion, nodau a chanlyniadau allweddol, a mesurau allweddol
- Senarios ar gyfer cynllunio beth-os, a chiw cychwyn sy'n cyfyngu ar waith ar y gweill

## Llywodraethu ac uwchgyfeirio

- Cofrestr risgiau a materion
- Adolygiadau giât, cymeradwyo cerrig milltir a phenderfyniadau newid drosodd
- Eithriadau gyda chloc, a llwybr uwchgyfeirio
- Pecynnau misol i gyfarwyddwyr
- Mathau o faterion a statwsau a ddiffinnir gan y sefydliad, gyda symudiadau statws a all amrywio yn ôl math o fater a chael eu cyfyngu yn ôl rôl

## Diogelwch a gweithrediadau

- Mewngofnodi yn ddiofyn, gyda mewngofnodi drwy ddarparwr hunaniaeth allanol, gan gynnwys Microsoft Entra ID drwy Keycloak
- Trywydd archwilio na ellir ei newid drwy'r gwasanaeth
- Cyfyngu cyfradd a phenawdau diogelwch
- Offer gwneud copi wrth gefn ac adfer, gydag ymarfer adfer wedi'i brofi

## Ddim ar gael eto

Nid yw'r fersiwn bresennol yn cynnwys:

- Ap symudol na rhaglen bwrdd gwaith
- Cyd-olygu amser real
- Sgrin i ddrafftio neu benderfynu ar geisiadau am newid, sydd ar gael drwy'r gwasanaeth yn unig
- PDF na sgrin ar gyfer pecynnau i gyfarwyddwyr, a ddarperir fel data, na sawl adran a gynlluniwyd

Mae'r [ôl-groniad prosiect](https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management/blob/main/tasks.md) yn cofnodi cyfyngiadau pob eitem.

# Tiwtorial

*Camau i redeg yr arddangosiad ar gyfrifiadur lleol ac adolygu portffolio enghreifftiol.*

Copi cyflawn o'r feddalwedd yw'r arddangosiad, wedi'i lwytho â data ar gyfer sefydliad ffug, y Northgate Transport Authority. Mae'r holl bobl, cynlluniau, ffigurau a dyddiadau yn ffug, a gellir newid y data yn rhydd.

**Nodyn diogelwch.** Mae'r arddangosiad yn ymddiried mewn allwedd brawf gyhoeddedig. Rhaid peidio â'i redeg ar rwydwaith a rennir na'i ddefnyddio gyda data go iawn.

## Gofynion

- [Git](https://git-scm.com/)
- [Podman](https://podman.io/) gyda Compose

## Cam 1: lawrlwytho'r cod

```sh
git clone https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management.git
cd project-portfolio-management
```

## Cam 2: cychwyn yr arddangosiad

```sh
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=demo podman compose --profile demo up -d --build --wait ui-demo
```

Mae'r gorchymyn hwn yn adeiladu'r feddalwedd, yn cychwyn y gronfa ddata, yn llwytho'r portffolio ffug ac yn cychwyn y rhyngwyneb. Mae'r adeiladu cyntaf yn cymryd yn hirach na'r rhai dilynol.

## Cam 3: mewngofnodi

Agorwch <http://localhost:3000/cy-001/signin>, gadewch y cyfeiriad fel `example@example.com` a gwasgwch y botwm mewngofnodi i'r arddangosiad. Ni anfonir e-bost.

Y dudalen gyntaf yw **taith yr arddangosiad**, sy'n rhestru pob nodwedd fesul grŵp, gyda disgrifiad a dolen. Mae baner felen ar bob tudalen yn nodi bod y data'n ffug.

## Cam 4: adolygu'r portffolio

O'r daith, agorwch y cynlluniau i weld y portffolio, ei raglenni a'i brosiectau. Yna agorwch ddangosfwrdd y portffolio.

## Cam 5: adolygu un prosiect

Agorwch y prosiect **North Line interlocking** drwy grŵp cyflawni'r daith. Adolygwch ei siart Gantt, ei lwybr critigol a'i werth a enillwyd.

## Cam 6: adolygu gwaith personol

Agorwch y dudalen waith bersonol a'r bwrdd kanban. Mae'r sesiwn wedi mewngofnodi fel Example Person, sydd â thasgau agored.

## Cam 7: adolygu capasiti, rheoli cychwyn ac adrodd

Agorwch y map gwres capasiti i weld adnoddau sydd wedi'u gor-archebu. Agorwch y ciw cychwyn, lle mae'r cyfyngiad ar waith ar y gweill wedi dal un rhaglen yn ôl. Agorwch y pecynnau i gyfarwyddwyr, y crynodeb misol sy'n cael ei rewi ar ôl ei gyhoeddi.

## Cam 8: stopio'r arddangosiad

Mae'r gorchymyn hwn yn stopio pob gwasanaeth ac yn dileu data'r arddangosiad:

```sh
podman compose --profile demo down -v
```

## Camau nesaf

- [Canllaw gosod](../../../../INSTALL.md), sy'n ymdrin â mewngofnodi a darparwyr hunaniaeth
- [Briffiau rôl](../../for/) ar gyfer rolau uwch
- [Canllaw arddangos](../../../../operations/demo.md)
- [Rhestr nodweddion](../nodweddion/index.md)

Gellir adrodd am broblemau drwy'r [traciwr materion](https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management/issues).

# Y llwybr i gynhyrchu

*Beth mae "cynhyrchu" yn ei olygu i'r feddalwedd hon, a pha mor bell ydyw oddi wrtho, fesul eitem.*

Mae "cynhyrchu" yma yn golygu bod sefydliad yn defnyddio'r feddalwedd ar gyfer gwaith go iawn. Mae cynlluniau go iawn,
enwau pobl go iawn a phenderfyniadau go iawn yn dibynnu arni, mae canlyniadau i doriad neu ollyngiad, ac mae rhywun yn
atebol amdani. Mewn corff iechyd mawr neu adran o'r llywodraeth, mae cynhyrchu hefyd yn golygu bod sicrwydd y sefydliad
ei hun wedi'i basio: prawf diogelwch, asesiad o'r effaith ar ddiogelu data, archwiliad hygyrchedd ac, yn y
Gwasanaeth Iechyd Gwladol, y Meini Prawf Asesu Technoleg Ddigidol (DTAC).

## Ble mae'n sefyll

- Ni honnir unrhyw ardystiad, cymeradwyaeth nac archwiliad. Amcangyfrif y prosiect ei hun yw'r dudalen hon.
- Mae "meddygol" yn golygu offeryn portffolio a phrosiect **anghlinigol**: dim cofnodion cleifion a dim cymorth
  penderfyniadau clinigol.
- Mae'r prosiect yn awgrymu dechrau gyda pheilot ar ddata anghlinigol, anghyfrinachol, a gynhelir gan sefydliad sy'n
  cwblhau ei sicrwydd ei hun.

## Parodrwydd, fesul eitem

Amcangyfrif y prosiect ar 13 Tachwedd 2026 yw pob ffigur, nid mesuriad. Mae pob llithrydd yn dechrau ar yr amcangyfrif
hwnnw. Mae symud llithrydd yn cofnodi eich barn eich hun wrth i chi ddarllen; nid oes dim yn cael ei gadw na'i anfon.

- **Sicrwydd diogelwch annibynnol** — 0%. Dim prawf treiddio, dim archwiliad trydydd parti a dim ardystiad. Rhaid i brynwr neu gyflenwr eu comisiynu (RG-13).
- **Hygyrchedd** — 40%. Mae archwiliad WCAG 2.2 AA awtomataidd yn rhedeg ar bob llwybr ar bob newid. Ni wnaed prawf â llaw, na phrawf gyda thechnoleg gynorthwyol neu gyda phobl anabl (RG-13).
- **Ceisiadau gwrthrych data** — 50%. Gall gweinyddwyr allforio a ffugenwi person ar draws pob cyfeiriad yn y sgema, gyda rhagolwg yn gyntaf (RG-6). Nid yw enwau a deipiwyd i deitlau, sylwadau neu ddogfennau, ffeiliau a lanlwythwyd, cipluniau archwilio a chopïau wrth gefn yn cael eu canfod yn awtomatig.
- **Cadw** — 35%. Mae carthiad, rhediad sych yn ddiofyn, yn cwmpasu hysbysiadau, logiau cyflwyno, allweddi analluedd a chipluniau tueddiadau a mabwysiadu, gyda chyfnodau wedi'u gosod fesul defnydd (RG-4). Cedwir cynlluniau, tasgau, cofnodion amser, dogfennau a'r trywydd archwilio nes i weithredwr eu dileu.
- **Marciau trin** — 60%. Mae dosbarthiad ffurfweddadwy yn cuddio cynlluniau uwchlaw cliriad y galwr, gweinyddwyr yn gynwysedig, ac yn labelu pob ymateb (RG-7). Nid yw'r marc wedi'i stampio i ffeiliau a gynhyrchir, ac mae'r cliriad cystal â phriodoledd y darparwr hunaniaeth yn unig.
- **Diogelwch atodiadau** — 50%. Rhaid i'r cynnwys gyfateb i'w fath datganedig, gwrthodir rhaglenni, ac mae sgan `clamd` dewisol yn methu'n gaeedig (RG-8). Nid oes sganiwr wedi'i gynnwys, ac mae'r bachyn wedi'i brofi yn erbyn dirprwy yn unig.
- **Adolygu mynediad a mynediad brys** — 45%. Mae adroddiad o'r caniatâd sy'n sefyll yn cefnogi ailardystio (RG-9), ac mae mynediad brys wedi'i gyfyngu o ran amser ac yn gofyn am reswm datganedig (RG-10). Mae'r adroddiad yn dangos yr hyn a gofnodwyd, nid yr hyn y mae'r darparwr hunaniaeth yn ei orfodi; nid oes llwybr i gofnodi penderfyniad adolygydd; a gall hysbysiad mynediad brys enwi rhywun nad yw'n derbyn dim tra bo'r caniatâd yn dal i sefyll.
- **Perfformiad a chapasiti** — 40%. Mae prawf llwyth a mwydo ar un peiriant yn [`BENCHMARKS.md`](../../../BENCHMARKS.md): mae ceisiadau cyffredin yn ateb mewn degau o filieiliadau, mae cynllun o tua 12,700 o dasgau yn araf i'w amserlennu, ac mae'r broses yn tyfu i tua 1 GB. Nid oes cynllun capasiti, dim prawf gyda llawer o ddefnyddwyr a dim rhediad ar draws sawl peiriant.
- **Sesiynau ar draws sawl gweinydd blaen** — 70%. Cedwir sesiynau yn y cof oni bai bod Redis wedi'i ffurfweddu (RG-12); gyda Redis, mae mewngofnodi'n dibynnu arno.
- **Cywirdeb y trywydd archwilio** — 50%. Archwilir ysgrifennu, ac mae sbardun cronfa ddata yn gwrthod newidiadau a dileadau, gydag eithriadau datganedig (RG-3). Gall gweinyddwr cronfa ddata ollwng y sbardun, ac nid oes cadwyn stwnsh.
- **Copïau wrth gefn ac adfer** — 80%. Profir adfer mewn integreiddio parhaus, plaen ac wedi'i amgryptio, yn erbyn targedau adfer datganedig (RG-5). Mae amgryptio'n ddewisol, ac mae'r ymarfer yn rhedeg ar CI y prosiect ei hun, nid ar letya'r defnyddiwr.
- **Cymorth a pharhad** — 10%. Un cynhaliwr a dim cytundeb lefel gwasanaeth ([`GOVERNANCE.md`](../../../GOVERNANCE.md)).
- **Cyfieithiadau** — 20%. Mae testun mewn ieithoedd heblaw Saesneg wedi'i ysgrifennu gan beiriant nes bod siaradwr yn ei adolygu, ac mae dyletswyddau iaith statudol angen testun a adolygwyd ([datganiad iaith](../../../governance/language-statement.md)).
- **Defnydd clinigol** — 0%. Ni ysgrifennwyd achos diogelwch clinigol, ac mae defnydd clinigol y tu allan i'r cwmpas.

## Beth ddylai defnydd cyntaf ei wneud

1. Cwblhau'r [rhestr wirio sicrwydd](../../../governance/assurance-checklist.md), gan ddechrau gyda phrawf treiddio ac archwiliad hygyrchedd.
2. Llenwi pob rhes "Buyer to complete" yn y [rhestr wirio DTAC](../../../governance/dtac-checklist.md) a'r marcwyr yn y [DPIA](../../../governance/dpia.md).
3. Cytuno ar gyfnodau cadw gyda'r rheolwr cofnodion ac amserlennu'r carthiad.
4. Troi copïau wrth gefn wedi'u hamgryptio ymlaen a rhedeg yr ymarfer adfer ar letya'r defnydd ei hun.
5. Cadw'r data yn anghlinigol ac islaw'r lefel marcio y sicrheir y defnydd ar ei chyfer.
6. Cynllunio ar gyfer y bylchau uchod, neu ariannu eu dileu.

Mae'r dystiolaeth ar gyfer pob eitem yn yr [asesiad](../../../governance/production-readiness.md).

# Rheoli Portffolio Prosiectau

*Cofrestr o waith a ariennir, gyda chanfod dyblygu a man gwaith rheoli prosiectau.*

Meddalwedd cod agored yw Rheoli Portffolio Prosiectau ar gyfer cofnodi'r cynlluniau y mae sefydliad yn eu hariannu a rheoli'r gwaith ynddynt. Mae'n cwmpasu tasgau, amserlenni, cost, adnoddau, risgiau a llywodraethu. Mae'n cymharu cynlluniau i nodi dyblygu posibl ac yn dangos y dystiolaeth ar gyfer pob paru. Pan na ellir cyfrifo ffigur, mae'r feddalwedd yn nodi'r rheswm.

## Prif fanteision

- **Un cofnod portffolio.** Mae portffolios, rhaglenni, prosiectau a chynhyrchion yn defnyddio un math o gofnod, a gall unrhyw gynllun gynnwys un arall. Mae adrodd yn defnyddio un rhestr ar draws pob adran.
- **Canfod dyblygu.** Mae paru'n cymharu cynlluniau a gofnodwyd dan enwau gwahanol ac yn dangos y dystiolaeth ar gyfer pob canlyniad, er mwyn i adolygwyr weithredu cyn ariannu'r ddau.
- **Ffigurau y gellir eu holrhain.** Dangosir ffigur coll gyda'r rheswm ei fod ar goll. Dangosir cynllun heb asesiad fel "heb ei asesu".
- **Trywydd archwilio.** Caiff pob newid ei archwilio. Ni all y sawl sy'n codi cais am newid ei gymeradwyo.
- **Rheoli mynediad.** Mae mewngofnodi ymlaen yn ddiofyn, ac nid yw'r gwasanaeth yn rhedeg wrth gynhyrchu gyda mewngofnodi wedi'i ddiffodd.
- **Defnyddio a thrwyddedu.** Mae'r feddalwedd yn cael ei hunan-letya a'i chynnig dan bum trwydded cod agored. Gellir mewnforio gwaith o Jira, Asana a Microsoft Project.

[Gweld yr holl fanteision](topics/manteision/index.md)

## Meysydd swyddogaethol

- **Cynlluniau a pharu.** Cofrestr ailadroddus, canfod dyblygu esboniadwy a chyfuno.
- **Cyflawni.** Byrddau kanban, siartiau Gantt, calendrau, cerrig milltir, llwybr critigol a chadwyn gritigol.
- **Cyllid.** Cyllidebau, cyfriflyfr cyllid, gwerth a enillwyd, a risg cost ac amserlen.
- **Adnoddau.** Cronfeydd sgiliau, map gwres capasiti a phobl allweddol.
- **Strategaeth.** Derbyn gwaith, syniadau, amcanion, nodau a chanlyniadau allweddol, a senarios.
- **Llywodraethu.** Risgiau, materion, adolygiadau giât, uwchgyfeirio a phecynnau misol i gyfarwyddwyr.

[Gweld yr holl nodweddion](topics/nodweddion/index.md)

## Defnyddwyr bwriedig

- **Swyddfeydd portffolio.** Adrodd ar draws rhaglenni a phrosiectau.
- **Rheolwyr prosiect a chyflawni.** Rheoli amserlenni, cost a risg.
- **Aelodau tîm.** Golwg bersonol ar y gwaith a neilltuwyd.
- **Uwch arweinwyr.** Mae'r [briffiau rôl](for/) yn nodi'r hyn y mae'r feddalwedd yn ei ddarparu i bob rôl, ei chyfyngiadau, a'r penderfyniadau sydd eu hangen.

## Statws presennol

Mae'r feddalwedd ar gam cynnar. Mae ganddi un cynhaliwr, dim archwiliad trydydd parti a dim cytundeb cymorth. Mae'r hyn y byddai defnydd cynhyrchu yn ei olygu, fesul eitem gydag amcangyfrif ar gyfer pob un, ar y dudalen [llwybr i gynhyrchu](path-to-production/index.md). Rhestrir y cyfyngiadau hysbys ar y [dudalen gymariaethau](topics/cymariaethau/index.md).

## Arddangosiad

Mae arddangosiad lleol yn defnyddio awdurdod trafnidiaeth ffug ac mae angen Git a Podman arno. Mae'r camau yn y [tiwtorial](topics/tiwtorial/index.md).
# Cymariaethau

*Crynodeb o'r ffordd y mae'r feddalwedd yn perthyn i gynhyrchion eraill.*

Mae gan y cynhyrchion isod ddibenion gwahanol ac ni chânt eu sgorio. Mae'r nodiadau hyn yn seiliedig ar ddeunydd cyhoeddus pob prosiect. **Ni osodwyd na rhedwyd unrhyw gynnyrch arall**, ac efallai fod pob un wedi newid ers hynny. Dylid gwirio dogfennau presennol y cynnyrch cyn gwneud penderfyniad.

| Prosiect | Beth ydyw | Ble mae'r prosiect hwn yn wahanol |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Leantime](https://github.com/leantime/leantime) | Rheoli prosiectau i bobl nad ydynt yn rheolwyr prosiect | Mae'r prosiect hwn hefyd yn cynnwys y swyddogaethau amserlennu, cost a llywodraethu a ddefnyddir gan swyddfa bortffolio |
| [Redmine](https://www.redmine.org/) | Offeryn cyffredinol ffurfweddadwy, gyda mathau, statwsau a rolau a ddiffinnir gan y sefydliad | Mae mathau o faterion, statwsau a llifoedd gwaith yn cael eu diffinio gan y sefydliad. Mae rolau'n cario caniatâd ar faterion, fesul cynllun, o fewn yr hyn y mae mewngofnodi rhywun yn ei ganiatáu. Gweler y [gymhariaeth â Redmine](../../../en-001/compare/redmine/index.md) (yn Saesneg) |
| Huly Platform (drwy ei fforc, Platform Collective) | Fframwaith cymwysiadau busnes ar lawer o wasanaethau | Platfform aml-wasanaeth yw Huly. Un gwasanaeth dros PostgreSQL yw'r prosiect hwn |
| [ProjectLibre](https://sourceforge.net/p/projectlibre/) | Dewis bwrdd gwaith yn lle Microsoft Project, ar gyfer un rheolwr ac un prosiect | Gwasanaeth aml-ddefnyddiwr wedi'i letya yw'r prosiect hwn, gyda rheoli mynediad |

## Cymariaethau cynnyrch

Tudalennau cymharu unigol (yn Saesneg): [Trello](../../../en-001/compare/trello/index.md), [Jira](../../../en-001/compare/jira/index.md), [Asana](../../../en-001/compare/asana/index.md), [Microsoft Project](../../../en-001/compare/microsoft-project/index.md), [Planview](../../../en-001/compare/planview/index.md), [Smartsheet](../../../en-001/compare/smartsheet/index.md), [Leantime](../../../en-001/compare/leantime/index.md), [Redmine](../../../en-001/compare/redmine/index.md), [ProjectLibre](../../../en-001/compare/projectlibre/index.md).

## Rhyngweithredu

- **Jira ac Asana:** mewnforio CSV, gyda rhagolwg a rheswm wedi'i nodi am bopeth a adawyd allan.
- **Microsoft Project:** mewnforio ac allforio XML MSPDI, sy'n cynnwys tasgau, amlinelliad, dyddiadau, hydoedd, cyfyngiadau, dibyniaethau a'r calendr. Mae aseineion, adnoddau a llinellau sylfaen wedi'u heithrio, ac mae'r ffeil yn cofnodi hyn.

## Gwahaniaethau dylunio

- **Rhesymau wedi'u nodi.** Dangosir ffigur coll gyda rheswm, er enghraifft "dim rhagolwg, oherwydd…".
- **Canfod dyblygu esboniadwy.** Mae paru'n gweithio ar draws pob math o gynllun ac yn dangos ei dystiolaeth.
- **Diofyn diogelwch.** Mae mewngofnodi ymlaen yn ddiofyn, ac mae deunydd diogelwch wedi'i gynnwys yn yr ystorfa.
- **Hydoedd penodol.** Nodir pob hyd mewn dyddiau calendr neu ddyddiau busnes.
- **Cyfyngiadau wedi'u cofnodi.** Mae'r ôl-groniad yn cofnodi cyfyngiadau pob eitem.

## Cyfyngiadau hysbys

- Dim ap symudol na rhaglen bwrdd gwaith.
- Dim cyd-olygu amser real.
- Un cynhaliwr, hanes cynhyrchu cyfyngedig a dim archwiliad trydydd parti.
- Rhedodd y prawf llwyth cyhoeddedig ar un peiriant. Mae'n dangos maint bras ac nid cynllun capasiti ydyw.
- Drafftiau yw'r cyfieithiadau, sy'n aros am adolygiad.
- Dim sgrin i ddrafftio neu benderfynu ar geisiadau am newid.
- Dim ecosystem ategion na marchnad.

Mae rhagor o fanylion yn y [nodiadau cymharu](https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management/blob/main/COMPARISONS.md). Gellir cyflwyno cywiriadau fel mater gyda ffynhonnell.

# Manteision

*Y prif fanteision i sefydliad, fesul maes.*

## Gwelededd portffolio

Yn aml, cedwir gwybodaeth portffolio mewn sawl lle. Yn y feddalwedd hon, un math o gofnod yw pob portffolio, rhaglen, prosiect a chynnyrch, sef **cynllun**. Gall unrhyw gynllun gynnwys unrhyw un arall, i unrhyw ddyfnder, felly gall y strwythur gyd-fynd â'r sefydliad. Mae label fel "Prosiect" yn ddisgrifiadol ac nid yw'n gosod unrhyw gyfyngiad ar gynllun.

## Lleihau dyblygu

Gall dwy adran siartio'r un fenter dan enwau gwahanol. Mae'r paru'n cymharu'r priodoleddau sy'n adnabod cynllun: enw, nodau, perchennog, noddwr, rhiant, amserlen, geiriau allweddol a dynodwyr. Mae'n gweithio ar draws pob math o gynllun ac yn dangos y dystiolaeth ar gyfer pob paru, a pherson sy'n gwneud y penderfyniad. Gellir cyfuno dau gofnod o un cynllun.

## Ansawdd adrodd

- Dangosir ffigur coll gyda rheswm, er enghraifft "dim rhagolwg, oherwydd…".
- Dangosir cynllun heb asesiad fel "heb ei asesu".
- Dangosir hyder cyflawni a gofnodwyd gan bobl wrth ymyl y statws a gyfrifir, a chedwir y ddau ar wahân.
- Mae cynlluniau preifat wedi'u heithrio o bob cyfanswm a chyfrif i bob defnyddiwr. Mae profion yn gwirio'r rheol hon.
- Mae pob hyd yn nodi a yw mewn dyddiau calendr neu ddyddiau busnes.

## Cofnodion penderfyniadau

Caiff pob newid ei archwilio, ac ni ellir newid y trywydd archwilio drwy'r gwasanaeth. Ni all y sawl sy'n codi cais am newid ei gymeradwyo. Caiff pecyn misol i gyfarwyddwyr ei ddrafftio unwaith, ei gyhoeddi gan berson a enwir ac yna ei rewi gan y gronfa ddata. Cyhoeddir cywiriad fel fersiwn newydd gyda nodyn.

## Diogelwch

Mae mewngofnodi ymlaen yn ddiofyn, ac nid yw'r gwasanaeth yn cychwyn wrth gynhyrchu gyda mewngofnodi wedi'i ddiffodd. Mae penawdau diogelwch, cyfyngu cyfradd, cynllun adfer gyda thargedau wedi'u nodi a phecyn llywodraethu gwybodaeth wedi'u cynnwys yn yr ystorfa.

## Rheolaeth a chludadwyedd

- **Trwyddedu.** Mae'r feddalwedd yn god agored, dan ddewis o MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, GPL-2.0 neu GPL-3.0.
- **Lletya.** Mae'r feddalwedd yn cael ei hunan-letya: un gwasanaeth Rust dros PostgreSQL, gyda rhyngwyneb SvelteKit.
- **Mewnforio data.** Gellir mewnforio ffeiliau CSV o Jira ac Asana, gyda rhagolwg a rheswm wedi'i nodi am unrhyw beth a eithrir. Gellir mewnforio ac allforio XML Microsoft Project.
- **Ieithoedd.** Mae'r rhyngwyneb ar gael mewn deg locale, gan gynnwys Arabeg o'r dde i'r chwith. Drafftiau yw'r cyfieithiadau, sy'n aros am adolygiad gan siaradwyr.

## Tudalennau cysylltiedig

Gweler hefyd y [nodweddion](../nodweddion/index.md), y [cymariaethau](../cymariaethau/index.md) a'r [tiwtorial](../tiwtorial/index.md).

# Nodweddion

*Crynodeb swyddogaethol fesul maes. Mae'r gofrestr a'r man gwaith prosiect yn rhannu un cofnod.*

## Cynlluniau a pharu

- Un casgliad ailadroddus o gynlluniau, gyda label dewisol fel Portffolio, Rhaglen neu Brosiect
- Paru dyblygu esboniadwy ar draws pob math o gynllun
- Cyfuno dau gofnod o un cynllun yn un cofnod

## Gwaith bob dydd

- Tudalen bersonol "Fy ngwaith" a bwrdd kanban personol
- Byrddau tasgau, calendrau a cherrig milltir
- Golygon wedi'u cadw, a chwilio ar draws y portffolio

## Amserlennu

- Siartiau Gantt a strwythur dadansoddiad gwaith
- Llwybr critigol, gyda'r wyth math o gyfyngiad Microsoft Project
- Llinellau sylfaen, iechyd amserlen a lefelu adnoddau
- Cadwyn gritigol, gyda byfferau, rheoli byfferau a'r drwm

## Arian

- Llinellau cyllideb, costau a chyfriflyfr cyllid
- Gwerth a enillwyd
- Risg cost, a risg cost ac amserlen gyda'i gilydd

## Pobl a chapasiti

- Adnoddau, rolau, cronfeydd sgiliau ac argaeledd
- Map gwres capasiti ac ymrwymiadau capasiti
- Pobl allweddol

## Strategaeth a derbyn gwaith

- Derbyn gwaith, gyda chynigion a syniadau
- Amcanion, nodau a chanlyniadau allweddol, a mesurau allweddol
- Senarios ar gyfer cynllunio beth-os, a chiw cychwyn sy'n cyfyngu ar waith ar y gweill

## Llywodraethu ac uwchgyfeirio

- Cofrestr risgiau a materion
- Adolygiadau giât, cymeradwyo cerrig milltir a phenderfyniadau newid drosodd
- Eithriadau gyda chloc, a llwybr uwchgyfeirio
- Pecynnau misol i gyfarwyddwyr
- Mathau o faterion a statwsau a ddiffinnir gan y sefydliad, gyda symudiadau statws a all amrywio yn ôl math o fater a chael eu cyfyngu yn ôl rôl

## Diogelwch a gweithrediadau

- Mewngofnodi yn ddiofyn, gyda mewngofnodi drwy ddarparwr hunaniaeth allanol, gan gynnwys Microsoft Entra ID drwy Keycloak
- Trywydd archwilio na ellir ei newid drwy'r gwasanaeth
- Cyfyngu cyfradd a phenawdau diogelwch
- Offer gwneud copi wrth gefn ac adfer, gydag ymarfer adfer wedi'i brofi

## Ddim ar gael eto

Nid yw'r fersiwn bresennol yn cynnwys:

- Ap symudol na rhaglen bwrdd gwaith
- Cyd-olygu amser real
- Sgrin i ddrafftio neu benderfynu ar geisiadau am newid, sydd ar gael drwy'r gwasanaeth yn unig
- PDF na sgrin ar gyfer pecynnau i gyfarwyddwyr, a ddarperir fel data, na sawl adran a gynlluniwyd

Mae'r [ôl-groniad prosiect](https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management/blob/main/tasks.md) yn cofnodi cyfyngiadau pob eitem.

# Tiwtorial

*Camau i redeg yr arddangosiad ar gyfrifiadur lleol ac adolygu portffolio enghreifftiol.*

Copi cyflawn o'r feddalwedd yw'r arddangosiad, wedi'i lwytho â data ar gyfer sefydliad ffug, y Northgate Transport Authority. Mae'r holl bobl, cynlluniau, ffigurau a dyddiadau yn ffug, a gellir newid y data yn rhydd.

**Nodyn diogelwch.** Mae'r arddangosiad yn ymddiried mewn allwedd brawf gyhoeddedig. Rhaid peidio â'i redeg ar rwydwaith a rennir na'i ddefnyddio gyda data go iawn.

## Gofynion

- [Git](https://git-scm.com/)
- [Podman](https://podman.io/) gyda Compose

## Cam 1: lawrlwytho'r cod

```sh
git clone https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management.git
cd project-portfolio-management
```

## Cam 2: cychwyn yr arddangosiad

```sh
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=demo podman compose --profile demo up -d --build --wait ui-demo
```

Mae'r gorchymyn hwn yn adeiladu'r feddalwedd, yn cychwyn y gronfa ddata, yn llwytho'r portffolio ffug ac yn cychwyn y rhyngwyneb. Mae'r adeiladu cyntaf yn cymryd yn hirach na'r rhai dilynol.

## Cam 3: mewngofnodi

Agorwch <http://localhost:3000/cy-001/signin>, gadewch y cyfeiriad fel `example@example.com` a gwasgwch y botwm mewngofnodi i'r arddangosiad. Ni anfonir e-bost.

Y dudalen gyntaf yw **taith yr arddangosiad**, sy'n rhestru pob nodwedd fesul grŵp, gyda disgrifiad a dolen. Mae baner felen ar bob tudalen yn nodi bod y data'n ffug.

## Cam 4: adolygu'r portffolio

O'r daith, agorwch y cynlluniau i weld y portffolio, ei raglenni a'i brosiectau. Yna agorwch ddangosfwrdd y portffolio.

## Cam 5: adolygu un prosiect

Agorwch y prosiect **North Line interlocking** drwy grŵp cyflawni'r daith. Adolygwch ei siart Gantt, ei lwybr critigol a'i werth a enillwyd.

## Cam 6: adolygu gwaith personol

Agorwch y dudalen waith bersonol a'r bwrdd kanban. Mae'r sesiwn wedi mewngofnodi fel Example Person, sydd â thasgau agored.

## Cam 7: adolygu capasiti, rheoli cychwyn ac adrodd

Agorwch y map gwres capasiti i weld adnoddau sydd wedi'u gor-archebu. Agorwch y ciw cychwyn, lle mae'r cyfyngiad ar waith ar y gweill wedi dal un rhaglen yn ôl. Agorwch y pecynnau i gyfarwyddwyr, y crynodeb misol sy'n cael ei rewi ar ôl ei gyhoeddi.

## Cam 8: stopio'r arddangosiad

Mae'r gorchymyn hwn yn stopio pob gwasanaeth ac yn dileu data'r arddangosiad:

```sh
podman compose --profile demo down -v
```

## Camau nesaf

- [Canllaw gosod](../../../../INSTALL.md), sy'n ymdrin â mewngofnodi a darparwyr hunaniaeth
- [Briffiau rôl](../../for/) ar gyfer rolau uwch
- [Canllaw arddangos](../../../../operations/demo.md)
- [Rhestr nodweddion](../nodweddion/index.md)

Gellir adrodd am broblemau drwy'r [traciwr materion](https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management/issues).

# Y llwybr i gynhyrchu

*Beth mae "cynhyrchu" yn ei olygu i'r feddalwedd hon, a pha mor bell ydyw oddi wrtho, fesul eitem.*

Mae "cynhyrchu" yma yn golygu bod sefydliad yn defnyddio'r feddalwedd ar gyfer gwaith go iawn. Mae cynlluniau go iawn,
enwau pobl go iawn a phenderfyniadau go iawn yn dibynnu arni, mae canlyniadau i doriad neu ollyngiad, ac mae rhywun yn
atebol amdani. Mewn corff iechyd mawr neu adran o'r llywodraeth, mae cynhyrchu hefyd yn golygu bod sicrwydd y sefydliad
ei hun wedi'i basio: prawf diogelwch, asesiad o'r effaith ar ddiogelu data, archwiliad hygyrchedd ac, yn y
Gwasanaeth Iechyd Gwladol, y Meini Prawf Asesu Technoleg Ddigidol (DTAC).

## Ble mae'n sefyll

- Ni honnir unrhyw ardystiad, cymeradwyaeth nac archwiliad. Amcangyfrif y prosiect ei hun yw'r dudalen hon.
- Mae "meddygol" yn golygu offeryn portffolio a phrosiect **anghlinigol**: dim cofnodion cleifion a dim cymorth
  penderfyniadau clinigol.
- Mae'r prosiect yn awgrymu dechrau gyda pheilot ar ddata anghlinigol, anghyfrinachol, a gynhelir gan sefydliad sy'n
  cwblhau ei sicrwydd ei hun.

## Parodrwydd, fesul eitem

Amcangyfrif y prosiect ar 13 Tachwedd 2026 yw pob ffigur, nid mesuriad. Mae pob llithrydd yn dechrau ar yr amcangyfrif
hwnnw. Mae symud llithrydd yn cofnodi eich barn eich hun wrth i chi ddarllen; nid oes dim yn cael ei gadw na'i anfon.

- **Sicrwydd diogelwch annibynnol** — 0%. Dim prawf treiddio, dim archwiliad trydydd parti a dim ardystiad. Rhaid i brynwr neu gyflenwr eu comisiynu (RG-13).
- **Hygyrchedd** — 40%. Mae archwiliad WCAG 2.2 AA awtomataidd yn rhedeg ar bob llwybr ar bob newid. Ni wnaed prawf â llaw, na phrawf gyda thechnoleg gynorthwyol neu gyda phobl anabl (RG-13).
- **Ceisiadau gwrthrych data** — 50%. Gall gweinyddwyr allforio a ffugenwi person ar draws pob cyfeiriad yn y sgema, gyda rhagolwg yn gyntaf (RG-6). Nid yw enwau a deipiwyd i deitlau, sylwadau neu ddogfennau, ffeiliau a lanlwythwyd, cipluniau archwilio a chopïau wrth gefn yn cael eu canfod yn awtomatig.
- **Cadw** — 35%. Mae carthiad, rhediad sych yn ddiofyn, yn cwmpasu hysbysiadau, logiau cyflwyno, allweddi analluedd a chipluniau tueddiadau a mabwysiadu, gyda chyfnodau wedi'u gosod fesul defnydd (RG-4). Cedwir cynlluniau, tasgau, cofnodion amser, dogfennau a'r trywydd archwilio nes i weithredwr eu dileu.
- **Marciau trin** — 60%. Mae dosbarthiad ffurfweddadwy yn cuddio cynlluniau uwchlaw cliriad y galwr, gweinyddwyr yn gynwysedig, ac yn labelu pob ymateb (RG-7). Nid yw'r marc wedi'i stampio i ffeiliau a gynhyrchir, ac mae'r cliriad cystal â phriodoledd y darparwr hunaniaeth yn unig.
- **Diogelwch atodiadau** — 50%. Rhaid i'r cynnwys gyfateb i'w fath datganedig, gwrthodir rhaglenni, ac mae sgan `clamd` dewisol yn methu'n gaeedig (RG-8). Nid oes sganiwr wedi'i gynnwys, ac mae'r bachyn wedi'i brofi yn erbyn dirprwy yn unig.
- **Adolygu mynediad a mynediad brys** — 45%. Mae adroddiad o'r caniatâd sy'n sefyll yn cefnogi ailardystio (RG-9), ac mae mynediad brys wedi'i gyfyngu o ran amser ac yn gofyn am reswm datganedig (RG-10). Mae'r adroddiad yn dangos yr hyn a gofnodwyd, nid yr hyn y mae'r darparwr hunaniaeth yn ei orfodi; nid oes llwybr i gofnodi penderfyniad adolygydd; a gall hysbysiad mynediad brys enwi rhywun nad yw'n derbyn dim tra bo'r caniatâd yn dal i sefyll.
- **Perfformiad a chapasiti** — 40%. Mae prawf llwyth a mwydo ar un peiriant yn [`BENCHMARKS.md`](../../../BENCHMARKS.md): mae ceisiadau cyffredin yn ateb mewn degau o filieiliadau, mae cynllun o tua 12,700 o dasgau yn araf i'w amserlennu, ac mae'r broses yn tyfu i tua 1 GB. Nid oes cynllun capasiti, dim prawf gyda llawer o ddefnyddwyr a dim rhediad ar draws sawl peiriant.
- **Sesiynau ar draws sawl gweinydd blaen** — 70%. Cedwir sesiynau yn y cof oni bai bod Redis wedi'i ffurfweddu (RG-12); gyda Redis, mae mewngofnodi'n dibynnu arno.
- **Cywirdeb y trywydd archwilio** — 50%. Archwilir ysgrifennu, ac mae sbardun cronfa ddata yn gwrthod newidiadau a dileadau, gydag eithriadau datganedig (RG-3). Gall gweinyddwr cronfa ddata ollwng y sbardun, ac nid oes cadwyn stwnsh.
- **Copïau wrth gefn ac adfer** — 80%. Profir adfer mewn integreiddio parhaus, plaen ac wedi'i amgryptio, yn erbyn targedau adfer datganedig (RG-5). Mae amgryptio'n ddewisol, ac mae'r ymarfer yn rhedeg ar CI y prosiect ei hun, nid ar letya'r defnyddiwr.
- **Cymorth a pharhad** — 10%. Un cynhaliwr a dim cytundeb lefel gwasanaeth ([`GOVERNANCE.md`](../../../GOVERNANCE.md)).
- **Cyfieithiadau** — 20%. Mae testun mewn ieithoedd heblaw Saesneg wedi'i ysgrifennu gan beiriant nes bod siaradwr yn ei adolygu, ac mae dyletswyddau iaith statudol angen testun a adolygwyd ([datganiad iaith](../../../governance/language-statement.md)).
- **Defnydd clinigol** — 0%. Ni ysgrifennwyd achos diogelwch clinigol, ac mae defnydd clinigol y tu allan i'r cwmpas.

## Beth ddylai defnydd cyntaf ei wneud

1. Cwblhau'r [rhestr wirio sicrwydd](../../../governance/assurance-checklist.md), gan ddechrau gyda phrawf treiddio ac archwiliad hygyrchedd.
2. Llenwi pob rhes "Buyer to complete" yn y [rhestr wirio DTAC](../../../governance/dtac-checklist.md) a'r marcwyr yn y [DPIA](../../../governance/dpia.md).
3. Cytuno ar gyfnodau cadw gyda'r rheolwr cofnodion ac amserlennu'r carthiad.
4. Troi copïau wrth gefn wedi'u hamgryptio ymlaen a rhedeg yr ymarfer adfer ar letya'r defnydd ei hun.
5. Cadw'r data yn anghlinigol ac islaw'r lefel marcio y sicrheir y defnydd ar ei chyfer.
6. Cynllunio ar gyfer y bylchau uchod, neu ariannu eu dileu.

Mae'r dystiolaeth ar gyfer pob eitem yn yr [asesiad](../../../governance/production-readiness.md).
# Weg in den Produktivbetrieb

*Was „Produktivbetrieb“ für diese Software bedeutet und wie weit sie davon entfernt ist, Punkt für Punkt.*

„Produktivbetrieb“ bedeutet hier, dass eine Organisation die Software für echte Arbeit einsetzt. Echte Pläne, die Namen
echter Menschen und echte Entscheidungen hängen davon ab, ein Ausfall oder ein Datenabfluss hat Folgen, und jemand ist
dafür verantwortlich. In einer großen Gesundheitseinrichtung oder einer Behörde bedeutet Produktivbetrieb außerdem, dass
die eigene Prüfung der Organisation bestanden ist: ein Sicherheitstest, eine Datenschutz-Folgenabschätzung, eine
Barrierefreiheitsprüfung und im britischen National Health Service die Digital Technology Assessment Criteria (DTAC).

## Wo sie steht

- Es wird keine Zertifizierung, Freigabe oder Prüfung behauptet. Diese Seite ist die eigene Schätzung des Projekts.
- „Medizinisch“ bedeutet ein **nichtklinisches** Portfolio- und Projektwerkzeug: keine Patientenakten und keine
  Unterstützung klinischer Entscheidungen.
- Das Projekt empfiehlt, mit einem Pilotbetrieb auf nichtklinischen, nicht geheimen Daten zu beginnen, durchgeführt von
  einer Organisation, die ihre eigene Prüfung abschließt.

## Reife, Punkt für Punkt

Jede Zahl ist die Schätzung des Projekts vom 13. November 2026, keine Messung. Jeder Schieberegler beginnt bei dieser
Schätzung. Wer einen Schieberegler bewegt, hält beim Lesen die eigene Einschätzung fest; nichts wird gespeichert oder
gesendet.

- **Unabhängige Sicherheitsprüfung** — 0%. Kein Penetrationstest, keine Prüfung durch Dritte und keine Zertifizierung. Ein Käufer oder ein Lieferant muss sie in Auftrag geben (RG-13).
- **Barrierefreiheit** — 40%. Bei jeder Änderung läuft für jede Route eine automatische Prüfung nach WCAG 2.2 AA. Ein manueller Test und ein Test mit assistiven Technologien oder mit Menschen mit Behinderungen wurden nicht durchgeführt (RG-13).
- **Anfragen betroffener Personen** — 50%. Administratoren können eine Person über jeden Verweis im Schema exportieren und pseudonymisieren, zuerst mit einer Vorschau (RG-6). Namen in Titeln, Kommentaren oder Dokumenten, hochgeladene Dateien, Prüfprotokoll-Momentaufnahmen und Sicherungen werden nicht automatisch gefunden.
- **Aufbewahrung** — 35%. Eine Bereinigung, standardmäßig als Probelauf, umfasst Benachrichtigungen, Zustellprotokolle, Idempotenzschlüssel sowie Trend- und Nutzungsmomentaufnahmen, mit Fristen je Installation (RG-4). Pläne, Aufgaben, Zeiterfassungen, Dokumente und das Prüfprotokoll bleiben erhalten, bis ein Betreiber sie löscht.
- **Einstufungsvermerke** — 60%. Eine konfigurierbare Einstufung verbirgt Pläne oberhalb der Freigabe des Aufrufers, auch vor Administratoren, und kennzeichnet jede Antwort (RG-7). Der Vermerk wird nicht in erzeugte Dateien eingeprägt, und die Freigabe ist nur so verlässlich wie das Attribut des Identitätsanbieters.
- **Sicherheit von Anhängen** — 50%. Der Inhalt muss zum angegebenen Typ passen, Programme werden abgewiesen, und eine optionale `clamd`-Prüfung schlägt sicher fehl (RG-8). Ein Virenscanner wird nicht mitgeliefert, und die Anbindung wurde nur gegen einen Platzhalter getestet.
- **Zugriffsüberprüfung und Notfallzugriff** — 45%. Ein Bericht über bestehende Berechtigungen unterstützt die Rezertifizierung (RG-9), und der Notfallzugriff ist zeitlich begrenzt und verlangt eine angegebene Begründung (RG-10). Der Bericht zeigt, was erfasst wurde, nicht was der Identitätsanbieter durchsetzt; es gibt keine Route, um die Entscheidung eines Prüfers festzuhalten; und eine Notfallzugriffsmeldung kann eine Person nennen, die nichts erhält, während die Berechtigung weiter besteht.
- **Leistung und Kapazität** — 40%. Ein Last- und Dauertest auf einem Rechner steht in [`BENCHMARKS.md`](../../../BENCHMARKS.md): Gewöhnliche Anfragen antworten in einigen zehn Millisekunden, ein Plan mit etwa 12.700 Aufgaben wird nur langsam terminiert, und der Prozess wächst auf etwa 1 GB. Es gibt keine Kapazitätsplanung, keinen Test mit vielen Nutzern und keinen Lauf über mehrere Rechner.
- **Sitzungen über mehrere Frontend-Server** — 70%. Sitzungen liegen im Arbeitsspeicher, sofern Redis nicht konfiguriert ist (RG-12); mit Redis hängt die Anmeldung davon ab.
- **Integrität des Prüfprotokolls** — 50%. Schreibvorgänge werden protokolliert, und ein Datenbank-Trigger weist Änderungen und Löschungen ab, mit angegebenen Ausnahmen (RG-3). Ein Datenbankadministrator kann den Trigger entfernen, und es gibt keine Hash-Kette.
- **Sicherung und Wiederherstellung** — 80%. Eine Wiederherstellung wird in der kontinuierlichen Integration getestet, unverschlüsselt und verschlüsselt, gegen angegebene Wiederherstellungsziele (RG-5). Die Verschlüsselung ist optional, und die Übung läuft auf der CI des Projekts, nicht beim Hosting des Betreibers.
- **Unterstützung und Fortbestand** — 10%. Ein Betreuer und keine Dienstgütevereinbarung ([`GOVERNANCE.md`](../../../GOVERNANCE.md)).
- **Übersetzungen** — 20%. Text in anderen Sprachen als Englisch ist maschinell geschrieben, bis eine sprachkundige Person ihn prüft, und gesetzliche Sprachpflichten verlangen geprüften Text ([Sprachenerklärung](../../../governance/language-statement.md)).
- **Klinische Nutzung** — 0%. Es wurde kein klinischer Sicherheitsnachweis geschrieben, und klinische Nutzung liegt außerhalb des Umfangs.

## Was ein erster Einsatz tun sollte

1. Die [Prüfliste](../../../governance/assurance-checklist.md) abschließen, beginnend mit einem Penetrationstest und einer Barrierefreiheitsprüfung.
2. Jede Zeile „Buyer to complete“ in der [DTAC-Checkliste](../../../governance/dtac-checklist.md) und die Markierungen in der [DPIA](../../../governance/dpia.md) ausfüllen.
3. Aufbewahrungsfristen mit der Schriftgutverwaltung vereinbaren und die Bereinigung einplanen.
4. Verschlüsselte Sicherungen einschalten und die Wiederherstellungsübung beim eigenen Hosting durchführen.
5. Die Daten nichtklinisch und unterhalb der Einstufung halten, für die der Einsatz geprüft ist.
6. Die oben genannten Lücken einplanen oder ihre Beseitigung finanzieren.

Die Belege zu jedem Punkt stehen in der [Bewertung](../../../governance/production-readiness.md).

# Project Portfolio Management

*A registry of funded work, with duplicate detection and a project management workspace.*

Project Portfolio Management is open-source software for recording the plans an organization funds and managing the work within them. It covers tasks, schedules, cost, resources, risks and governance. It compares plans to identify possible duplicates and shows the evidence for each match. Where a figure cannot be calculated, the software states the reason.

## Main benefits

- **Single portfolio record.** Portfolios, programmes, projects and products use one record type, and any plan can contain another. Reporting draws on one list across all departments.
- **Duplicate detection.** Matching compares plans recorded under different names and shows the evidence for each result, so that reviewers can act before both are funded.
- **Traceable figures.** A missing figure is shown with the reason it is missing. A plan without an assessment is shown as "not assessed".
- **Audit trail.** Every change is audited. The person who raises a change request cannot approve it.
- **Access control.** Login is on by default, and the service does not run in production with login turned off.
- **Deployment and licensing.** The software is self-hosted and offered under five open-source licences. Work can be imported from Jira, Asana and Microsoft Project.

[View all benefits](topics/benefits/index.md)

## Functional areas

- **Plans and matching.** Recursive registry, explainable duplicate detection and merging.
- **Delivery.** Kanban boards, Gantt charts, calendars, milestones, critical path and critical chain.
- **Finance.** Budgets, funding ledger, earned value, and cost and schedule risk.
- **Resources.** Skill pools, capacity heatmap and key people.
- **Strategy.** Work intake, ideas, objectives, goals and key results, and scenarios.
- **Governance.** Risks, issues, gate reviews, escalation and monthly director packs.

[View all features](topics/features/index.md)

## Intended users

- **Portfolio offices.** Reporting across programmes and projects.
- **Project and delivery managers.** Scheduling, cost and risk management.
- **Team members.** A personal view of assigned work.
- **Senior leaders.** The [role briefs](for/) set out what the software provides for each role, its limits, and the decisions required.

## Current status

The software is at an early stage. It has one maintainer, no third-party audit and no support agreement. What production use would take, item by item with an estimate for each, is on the [path to production](path-to-production/index.md) page. Known limitations are listed on the [comparisons page](topics/comparisons/index.md).

## Demonstration

A local demonstration uses a fictitious transport authority and requires Git and Podman. The steps are in the [tutorial](topics/tutorial/index.md).

# Benefits

*The main benefits for an organization, by area.*

## Portfolio visibility

Portfolio information is often held in several places. In this software, every portfolio, programme, project and product is one record type, called a **plan**. Any plan can contain any other, to any depth, so the structure can match the organization. A label such as "Project" is descriptive and places no restriction on a plan.

## Duplicate reduction

Two departments can charter the same initiative under different names. The matcher compares the attributes that identify a plan: name, goals, owner, sponsor, parent, timeframe, keywords and identifiers. It works across all plan types and shows the evidence for each match, and a person makes the decision. Two records of one plan can be merged.

## Reporting quality

- A missing figure is shown with a reason, for example "no forecast, because…".
- A plan without an assessment is shown as "not assessed".
- Delivery confidence recorded by people is shown beside the calculated status, and the two are kept separate.
- Private plans are excluded from all totals and counts for all users. Tests check this rule.
- Each duration states whether it is in calendar days or business days.

## Decision records

Every change is audited, and the audit trail cannot be altered through the service. The person who raises a change request cannot approve it. A monthly director pack is drafted once, issued by a named person and then frozen by the database. A correction is issued as a new version with a note.

## Security

Login is on by default, and the service does not start in production with login turned off. Security headers, rate limiting, a recovery plan with stated targets and an information governance pack are included in the repository.

## Control and portability

- **Licensing.** The software is open source, under a choice of MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, GPL-2.0 or GPL-3.0.
- **Hosting.** The software is self-hosted: one Rust service over PostgreSQL, with a SvelteKit interface.
- **Data import.** CSV files from Jira and Asana can be imported, with a preview and a stated reason for anything excluded. Microsoft Project XML can be imported and exported.
- **Languages.** The interface is available in ten locales, including right-to-left Arabic. The translations are drafts awaiting review by speakers.

## Related pages

See also [features](../features/index.md), [comparisons](../comparisons/index.md) and the [tutorial](../tutorial/index.md).
# Comparisons

*A summary of how the software relates to other products.*

The products below serve different purposes and are not scored. These notes are based on each project's public material. **No other product was installed or run**, and each may have changed since. Current product documentation should be checked before a decision is made.

| Project | What it is | Where this project differs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Leantime](https://github.com/leantime/leantime) | Project management for people who are not project managers | This project also includes the scheduling, cost and governance functions used by a portfolio office |
| [Redmine](https://www.redmine.org/) | A configurable general-purpose tracker, with organization-defined issue types, statuses and roles | Issue types, statuses and workflows are organization-defined. Roles carry issue permissions, held plan by plan, within what a person's sign-in allows. See the [Redmine comparison](../../../en-001/compare/redmine/index.md) |
| Huly Platform (through its fork, Platform Collective) | A business application framework on many services | Huly is a multi-service platform. This project is one service over PostgreSQL |
| [ProjectLibre](https://sourceforge.net/p/projectlibre/) | A desktop alternative to Microsoft Project, for one manager and one project | This project is a hosted, multi-user service with access control |

## Product comparisons

Individual comparison pages: [Trello](../../../en-001/compare/trello/index.md), [Jira](../../../en-001/compare/jira/index.md), [Asana](../../../en-001/compare/asana/index.md), [Microsoft Project](../../../en-001/compare/microsoft-project/index.md), [Planview](../../../en-001/compare/planview/index.md), [Smartsheet](../../../en-001/compare/smartsheet/index.md), [Leantime](../../../en-001/compare/leantime/index.md), [Redmine](../../../en-001/compare/redmine/index.md), [ProjectLibre](../../../en-001/compare/projectlibre/index.md).

## Interoperability

- **Jira and Asana:** CSV import, with a preview and a stated reason for everything left out.
- **Microsoft Project:** import and export of MSPDI XML, covering tasks, outline, dates, durations, constraints, dependencies and the calendar. Assignees, resources and baselines are excluded, and the file records this.

## Design differences

- **Stated reasons.** A missing figure is shown with a reason, for example "no forecast, because…".
- **Explainable duplicate detection.** Matching works across all plan types and shows its evidence.
- **Security defaults.** Login is on by default, and security material is included in the repository.
- **Explicit durations.** Each duration is stated in calendar days or business days.
- **Recorded limits.** The backlog records the limits of each item.

## Known limitations

- No mobile app or desktop application.
- No real-time co-editing.
- One maintainer, a limited production history and no third-party audit.
- The published load test ran on one machine. It indicates an order of magnitude and is not a capacity plan.
- The translations are drafts awaiting review.
- No screen for drafting or deciding change requests.
- No plugin or marketplace ecosystem.

Further detail is in the [comparison notes](https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management/blob/main/COMPARISONS.md). Corrections can be submitted as an issue with a source.

# Tutorial

*Steps to run the demonstration on a local computer and review a sample portfolio.*

The demonstration is a complete copy of the software, loaded with data for a fictitious organization, the Northgate Transport Authority. All people, plans, figures and dates are fictitious, and the data can be changed freely.

**Security note.** The demonstration trusts a published test key. It must not be run on a shared network or used with real data.

## Requirements

- [Git](https://git-scm.com/)
- [Podman](https://podman.io/) with Compose

## Step 1: download the code

```sh
git clone https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management.git
cd project-portfolio-management
```

## Step 2: start the demonstration

```sh
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=demo podman compose --profile demo up -d --build --wait ui-demo
```

This command builds the software, starts the database, loads the fictitious portfolio and starts the interface. The first build takes longer than later ones.

## Step 3: sign in

Open <http://localhost:3000/en-001/signin>, leave the address as `example@example.com` and press **Sign in to the demonstration**. No email is sent.

The first page is the **demonstration tour**, which lists every feature by group, with a description and a link. A yellow banner on every page states that the data is fictitious.

## Step 4: review the portfolio

From the tour, open **Plans** to view the portfolio, its programmes and its projects. Then open the **Portfolio dashboard**.

## Step 5: review one project

Open the **North Line interlocking** project through the tour's delivery group. Review its **Gantt** chart, **Critical path** and **Earned value**.

## Step 6: review personal work

Open **My work** and **My kanban board**. The session is signed in as Example Person, who has open tasks.

## Step 7: review capacity, start control and reporting

Open **Capacity heatmap** to view over-booked resources. Open **Start queue**, where the work-in-progress limit has held back one programme. Open **Director packs**, the monthly summary that is frozen once issued.

## Step 8: stop the demonstration

This command stops all services and deletes the demonstration data:

```sh
podman compose --profile demo down -v
```

## Next steps

- [Installation guide](../../../../INSTALL.md), covering login and identity providers
- [Role briefs](../../for/) for senior roles
- [Demonstration guide](../../../../operations/demo.md)
- [Feature list](../features/index.md)

Problems can be reported through the [issue tracker](https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management/issues).

# Project Portfolio Management and Redmine

*Two configurable issue models, and where they differ.*

**Basis of this comparison.** The Redmine column of the table below was checked on 5 November 2026 against Redmine's own documentation: [roles and permissions](https://www.redmine.org/projects/redmine/wiki/RedmineRoles), [issue tracking setup](https://www.redmine.org/projects/redmine/wiki/RedmineIssueTrackingSetup) and [project settings](https://www.redmine.org/projects/redmine/wiki/RedmineProjectSettings). Redmine was not installed or run, and the rest of this page is a general description. Products are not scored. Statements about this project are taken from its repository.

## About Redmine

A long-established, configurable, open-source project tracker in which the organization defines issue types, statuses, custom fields and roles.

## When Redmine may be the better fit

- Roles need to govern more than issue actions, such as notes, watchers, saved queries and which issues a member can see
- Project members, not only administrators, need to manage their own project's members and trackers
- Groups need to hold roles, or field rules need to cover custom fields
- A long production history and a large plugin ecosystem are required

## When this project may be the better fit

- Issue types, statuses, roles and field rules are needed alongside a portfolio registry
- Portfolio views, critical path, earned value and governance are required
- Explainable duplicate matching is required

## Issue configuration compared

| Concept | Redmine | This project |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Issue types | Trackers, defined by an administrator. Each project selects the ones it uses, and project members with the permission can make that selection | Issue types, defined by an administrator for the whole deployment. An administrator can limit a plan to some of them. A type is retired, never deleted |
| Statuses | A shared list of statuses. More than one can be marked closed, and each can set a percent done | The states of a workflow. Each state declares what it means (not started, active, waiting or done), and totals and overdue figures use that meaning |
| Roles | A named set of permissions across issues, notes, watchers, queries and more. A role can also narrow which issues its holder sees | A named set of four issue permissions: add, edit, move and remove. Permissions can only narrow what a person's sign-in allows, and what they can see is decided by the plan's privacy |
| Members | A user or a group holds one or more roles on a project, and the permissions combine | A person holds one or more roles on a plan, and the permissions combine. A plan is unaffected until it has its first member. Only an administrator changes membership, and groups cannot hold a role |
| Workflow | Allowed status changes for each combination of role and tracker | Allowed moves for a workflow, each open to anyone or to named roles. A workflow can apply to one issue type, to one plan, or to both |
| Field rules | Per status, a field can be read-only or required, for each role and tracker. This includes custom fields | Per status, one of seven standard fields can be read-only or required, for everyone or named roles. Custom fields are not covered. An administrator is not bound by read-only |
| Translated names | Not checked for this comparison | An organization can give each issue type, role and status a name per language |

## Migration

There is **no Redmine importer**. This project adopted ideas from Redmine but no code: custom fields, per-plan modules, watchers and approvals.

## Project status

This project is at an early stage, with one maintainer and no third-party audit. What production use would take, item by item with an estimate for each, is on the [path to production](../../path-to-production/index.md) page. It has no mobile app and no real-time co-editing. See [known limitations](../../topics/comparisons/index.md#known-limitations).

Corrections can be submitted as an [issue](https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management/issues) with a source.

# Path to production

*What "production" means for this software, and how far it is from it, item by item.*

"Production" here means that an organization runs the software for real work. Real plans, real people's names and
real decisions depend on it, an outage or a leak has consequences, and someone is answerable for it. At a large health
body or a government department, production also means that the organization's own assurance has been passed: a
security test, a data protection impact assessment, an accessibility audit and, in the National Health Service, the
Digital Technology Assessment Criteria (DTAC).

## Where it stands

- No certification, approval or audit is claimed. This page is the project's own estimate.
- "Medical" means a **non-clinical** portfolio and project tool: no patient records and no clinical decision support.
- The project suggests starting with a pilot on non-clinical, non-secret data, run by an organization that completes
  its own assurance.

## Readiness, item by item

Each figure is the project's estimate on 13 November 2026, not a measurement. Each slider starts at that estimate.
Moving a slider records your own view while you read; nothing is saved or sent.

- **Independent security assurance** — 0%. No penetration test, no third-party audit and no certification. A buyer or a supplier has to commission them (RG-13).
- **Accessibility** — 40%. An automated WCAG 2.2 AA audit runs on every route on every change. No manual test, and no test with assistive technology or with disabled people, has been done (RG-13).
- **Data-subject requests** — 50%. Administrators can export and pseudonymize a person across every reference in the schema, with a preview first (RG-6). Names typed into titles, comments or documents, uploaded files, audit snapshots and backups are not found automatically.
- **Retention** — 35%. A purge, dry run by default, covers notifications, delivery logs, idempotency keys and trend and adoption snapshots, with periods set per deployment (RG-4). Plans, tasks, time records, documents and the audit trail are kept until an operator deletes them.
- **Handling marks** — 60%. A configurable classification hides plans above a caller's clearance, administrators included, and labels every response (RG-7). The mark is not stamped into generated files, and the clearance is only as good as the identity provider's attribute.
- **Attachment safety** — 50%. Content must match its declared type, programs are refused, and an optional `clamd` scan fails closed (RG-8). No scanner is bundled, and the hook has been tested only against a stand-in.
- **Access review and emergency access** — 45%. A report of standing grants supports recertification (RG-9), and emergency access is time-limited and needs a stated reason (RG-10). The report shows what was recorded, not what the identity provider enforces; no route records a reviewer's decision; and an emergency-access notice can name someone who receives nothing while the grant still stands.
- **Performance and capacity** — 40%. A load and soak test on one machine is in [`BENCHMARKS.md`](../../../BENCHMARKS.md): ordinary requests answer in tens of milliseconds, a plan of about 12,700 tasks is slow to schedule, and the process grows to about 1 GB. There is no capacity plan, no test with many users and no run across several machines.
- **Sessions across several front-end servers** — 70%. Sessions are held in memory unless Redis is configured (RG-12); with Redis, signing in depends on it.
- **Audit trail integrity** — 50%. Writes are audited, and a database trigger refuses changes and deletions, with stated exceptions (RG-3). A database administrator can drop the trigger, and there is no hash chain.

# Project Portfolio Management

*A registry of funded work, with duplicate detection and a project management workspace.*

Project Portfolio Management is open-source software for recording the plans an organisation funds and managing the work within them. It covers tasks, schedules, cost, resources, risks and governance. It compares plans to identify possible duplicates and shows the evidence for each match. Where a figure cannot be calculated, the software states the reason.

## Main benefits

- **Single portfolio record.** Portfolios, programmes, projects and products use one record type, and any plan can contain another. Reporting draws on one list across all departments.
- **Duplicate detection.** Matching compares plans recorded under different names and shows the evidence for each result, so that reviewers can act before both are funded.
- **Traceable figures.** A missing figure is shown with the reason it is missing. A plan without an assessment is shown as "not assessed".
- **Audit trail.** Every change is audited. The person who raises a change request cannot approve it.
- **Access control.** Login is on by default, and the service does not run in production with login turned off.
- **Deployment and licensing.** The software is self-hosted and offered under five open-source licences. Work can be imported from Jira, Asana and Microsoft Project.

[View all benefits](topics/benefits/index.md)

## Functional areas

- **Plans and matching.** Recursive registry, explainable duplicate detection and merging.
- **Delivery.** Kanban boards, Gantt charts, calendars, milestones, critical path and critical chain.
- **Finance.** Budgets, funding ledger, earned value, and cost and schedule risk.
- **Resources.** Skill pools, capacity heatmap and key people.
- **Strategy.** Work intake, ideas, objectives, goals and key results, and scenarios.
- **Governance.** Risks, issues, gate reviews, escalation and monthly director packs.

[View all features](topics/features/index.md)

## Intended users

- **Portfolio offices.** Reporting across programmes and projects.
- **Project and delivery managers.** Scheduling, cost and risk management.
- **Team members.** A personal view of assigned work.
- **Senior leaders.** The [role briefs](for/) set out what the software provides for each role, its limits, and the decisions required.

## Current status

The software is at an early stage. It has one maintainer, no third-party audit and no support agreement. What production use would take, item by item with an estimate for each, is on the [path to production](path-to-production/index.md) page. Known limitations are listed on the [comparisons page](topics/comparisons/index.md).

# Benefits

*The main benefits for an organisation, by area.*

## Portfolio visibility

Portfolio information is often held in several places. In this software, every portfolio, programme, project and product is one record type, called a **plan**. Any plan can contain any other, to any depth, so the structure can match the organisation. A label such as "Project" is descriptive and places no restriction on a plan.

## Duplicate reduction

Two departments can charter the same initiative under different names. The matcher compares the attributes that identify a plan: name, goals, owner, sponsor, parent, timeframe, keywords and identifiers. It works across all plan types and shows the evidence for each match, and a person makes the decision. Two records of one plan can be merged.

## Reporting quality

- A missing figure is shown with a reason, for example "no forecast, because…".
- A plan without an assessment is shown as "not assessed".
- Delivery confidence recorded by people is shown beside the calculated status, and the two are kept separate.
- Private plans are excluded from all totals and counts for all users. Tests check this rule.
- Each duration states whether it is in calendar days or business days.

## Decision records

Every change is audited, and the audit trail cannot be altered through the service. The person who raises a change request cannot approve it. A monthly director pack is drafted once, issued by a named person and then frozen by the database. A correction is issued as a new version with a note.

## Security

Login is on by default, and the service does not start in production with login turned off. Security headers, rate limiting, a recovery plan with stated targets and an information governance pack are included in the repository.

## Control and portability

- **Licensing.** The software is open source, under a choice of MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, GPL-2.0 or GPL-3.0.
- **Hosting.** The software is self-hosted: one Rust service over PostgreSQL, with a SvelteKit interface.
- **Data import.** CSV files from Jira and Asana can be imported, with a preview and a stated reason for anything excluded. Microsoft Project XML can be imported and exported.
- **Languages.** The interface is available in ten locales, including right-to-left Arabic. The translations are drafts awaiting review by speakers.

## Related pages

See also [features](../features/index.md), [comparisons](../comparisons/index.md) and the [tutorial](../tutorial/index.md).

# Tutorial

*Steps to run the demonstration on a local computer and review a sample portfolio.*

The demonstration is a complete copy of the software, loaded with data for a fictitious organisation, the Northgate Transport Authority. All people, plans, figures and dates are fictitious, and the data can be changed freely.

**Security note.** The demonstration trusts a published test key. It must not be run on a shared network or used with real data.

## Requirements

- [Git](https://git-scm.com/)
- [Podman](https://podman.io/) with Compose

## Step 1: download the code

```sh
git clone https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management.git
cd project-portfolio-management
```

## Step 2: start the demonstration

```sh
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=demo podman compose --profile demo up -d --build --wait ui-demo
```

This command builds the software, starts the database, loads the fictitious portfolio and starts the interface. The first build takes longer than later ones.

## Step 3: sign in

Open <http://localhost:3000/en-001/signin>, leave the address as `example@example.com` and press **Sign in to the demonstration**. No email is sent.

The first page is the **demonstration tour**, which lists every feature by group, with a description and a link. A yellow banner on every page states that the data is fictitious.

## Step 4: review the portfolio

From the tour, open **Plans** to view the portfolio, its programmes and its projects. Then open the **Portfolio dashboard**.

## Step 5: review one project

Open the **North Line interlocking** project through the tour's delivery group. Review its **Gantt** chart, **Critical path** and **Earned value**.

## Step 6: review personal work

Open **My work** and **My kanban board**. The session is signed in as Example Person, who has open tasks.

## Step 7: review capacity, start control and reporting

Open **Capacity heatmap** to view over-booked resources. Open **Start queue**, where the work-in-progress limit has held back one programme. Open **Director packs**, the monthly summary that is frozen once issued.

## Step 8: stop the demonstration

This command stops all services and deletes the demonstration data:

```sh
podman compose --profile demo down -v
```

## Next steps

- [Installation guide](../../../../INSTALL.md), covering login and identity providers
- [Role briefs](../../for/) for senior roles
- [Demonstration guide](../../../../operations/demo.md)
- [Feature list](../features/index.md)

Problems can be reported through the [issue tracker](https://github.com/project-portfolio-management/project-portfolio-management/issues).

# Path to production

*What "production" means for this software, and how far it is from it, item by item.*

"Production" here means that an organisation runs the software for real work. Real plans, real people's names and
real decisions depend on it, an outage or a leak has consequences, and someone is answerable for it. At a large health
body or a government department, production also means that the organisation's own assurance has been passed: a
security test, a data protection impact assessment, an accessibility audit and, in the National Health Service, the
Digital Technology Assessment Criteria (DTAC).

## Where it stands

- No certification, approval or audit is claimed. This page is the project's own estimate.
- "Medical" means a **non-clinical** portfolio and project tool: no patient records and no clinical decision support.
- The project suggests starting with a pilot on non-clinical, non-secret data, run by an organisation that completes
  its own assurance.

## Readiness, item by item

Each figure is the project's estimate on 13 November 2026, not a measurement. Each slider starts at that estimate.
Moving a slider records your own view while you read; nothing is saved or sent.

- **Independent security assurance** — 0%. No penetration test, no third-party audit and no certification. A buyer or a supplier has to commission them (RG-13).
- **Accessibility** — 40%. An automated WCAG 2.2 AA audit runs on every route on every change. No manual test, and no test with assistive technology or with disabled people, has been done (RG-13).
- **Data-subject requests** — 50%. Administrators can export and pseudonymise a person across every reference in the schema, with a preview first (RG-6). Names typed into titles, comments or documents, uploaded files, audit snapshots and backups are not found automatically.
- **Retention** — 35%. A purge, dry run by default, covers notifications, delivery logs, idempotency keys and trend and adoption snapshots, with periods set per deployment (RG-4). Plans, tasks, time records, documents and the audit trail are kept until an operator deletes them.
- **Handling marks** — 60%. A configurable classification hides plans above a caller's clearance, administrators included, and labels every response (RG-7). The mark is not stamped into generated files, and the clearance is only as good as the identity provider's attribute.
- **Attachment safety** — 50%. Content must match its declared type, programs are refused, and an optional `clamd` scan fails closed (RG-8). No scanner is bundled, and the hook has been tested only against a stand-in.
- **Access review and emergency access** — 45%. A report of standing grants supports recertification (RG-9), and emergency access is time-limited and needs a stated reason (RG-10). The report shows what was recorded, not what the identity provider enforces; no route records a reviewer's decision; and an emergency-access notice can name someone who receives nothing while the grant still stands.
- **Performance and capacity** — 40%. A load and soak test on one machine is in [`BENCHMARKS.md`](../../../BENCHMARKS.md): ordinary requests answer in tens of milliseconds, a plan of about 12,700 tasks is slow to schedule, and the process grows to about 1 GB. There is no capacity plan, no test with many users and no run across several machines.
- **Sessions across several front-end servers** — 70%. Sessions are held in memory unless Redis is configured (RG-12); with Redis, signing in depends on it.
- **Audit trail integrity** — 50%. Writes are audited, and a database trigger refuses changes and deletions, with stated exceptions (RG-3). A database administrator can drop the trigger, and there is no hash chain.
- **Backup and recovery** — 80%. A restore is tested in continuous integration, plain and encrypted, against stated recovery targets (RG-5). Encryption is optional, and the drill runs on the project's own CI, not on the deployer's hosting.
- **Support and continuity** — 10%. One maintainer and no service-level agreement ([`GOVERNANCE.md`](../../../GOVERNANCE.md)).
- **Translations** — 20%. Text in languages other than English is machine-written until a speaker reviews it, and statutory language duties need reviewed text ([language statement](../../../governance/language-statement.md)).
- **Clinical use** — 0%. No clinical safety case has been written, and clinical use is out of scope.

## What a first deployment should do

1. Complete the [assurance checklist](../../../governance/assurance-checklist.md), starting with a penetration test and an accessibility audit.
2. Fill every "Buyer to complete" row in the [DTAC checklist](../../../governance/dtac-checklist.md) and the markers in the [DPIA](../../../governance/dpia.md).
3. Agree retention periods with the records manager and schedule the purge.
4. Turn on encrypted backups and run the restore drill on the deployment's own hosting.
5. Keep the data non-clinical and below the marking level the deployment is assured for.
6. Plan for the gaps above, or fund their removal.

The evidence for each item is in the [assessment](../../../governance/production-readiness.md).

# Path to production

*What "production" means for this software, and how far it is from it, item by item.*

"Production" here means that an organization runs the software for real work. Real plans, real people's names and
real decisions depend on it, an outage or a leak has consequences, and someone is answerable for it. At a large health
body or a government department, production also means that the organization's own assurance has been passed: a
security test, a data protection impact assessment, an accessibility audit and, in the National Health Service, the
Digital Technology Assessment Criteria (DTAC).

## Where it stands

- No certification, approval or audit is claimed. This page is the project's own estimate.
- "Medical" means a **non-clinical** portfolio and project tool: no patient records and no clinical decision support.
- The project suggests starting with a pilot on non-clinical, non-secret data, run by an organization that completes
  its own assurance.

## Readiness, item by item

Each figure is the project's estimate on 13 November 2026, not a measurement. Each slider starts at that estimate.
Moving a slider records your own view while you read; nothing is saved or sent.

- **Independent security assurance** — 0%. No penetration test, no third-party audit and no certification. A buyer or a supplier has to commission them (RG-13).
- **Accessibility** — 40%. An automated WCAG 2.2 AA audit runs on every route on every change. No manual test, and no test with assistive technology or with disabled people, has been done (RG-13).
- **Data-subject requests** — 50%. Administrators can export and pseudonymize a person across every reference in the schema, with a preview first (RG-6). Names typed into titles, comments or documents, uploaded files, audit snapshots and backups are not found automatically.
- **Retention** — 35%. A purge, dry run by default, covers notifications, delivery logs, idempotency keys and trend and adoption snapshots, with periods set per deployment (RG-4). Plans, tasks, time records, documents and the audit trail are kept until an operator deletes them.
- **Handling marks** — 60%. A configurable classification hides plans above a caller's clearance, administrators included, and labels every response (RG-7). The mark is not stamped into generated files, and the clearance is only as good as the identity provider's attribute.
- **Attachment safety** — 50%. Content must match its declared type, programs are refused, and an optional `clamd` scan fails closed (RG-8). No scanner is bundled, and the hook has been tested only against a stand-in.
- **Access review and emergency access** — 45%. A report of standing grants supports recertification (RG-9), and emergency access is time-limited and needs a stated reason (RG-10). The report shows what was recorded, not what the identity provider enforces; no route records a reviewer's decision; and an emergency-access notice can name someone who receives nothing while the grant still stands.
- **Performance and capacity** — 40%. A load and soak test on one machine is in [`BENCHMARKS.md`](../../../BENCHMARKS.md): ordinary requests answer in tens of milliseconds, a plan of about 12,700 tasks is slow to schedule, and the process grows to about 1 GB. There is no capacity plan, no test with many users and no run across several machines.
- **Sessions across several front-end servers** — 70%. Sessions are held in memory unless Redis is configured (RG-12); with Redis, signing in depends on it.
- **Audit trail integrity** — 50%. Writes are audited, and a database trigger refuses changes and deletions, with stated exceptions (RG-3). A database administrator can drop the trigger, and there is no hash chain.
- **Backup and recovery** — 80%. A restore is tested in continuous integration, plain and encrypted, against stated recovery targets (RG-5). Encryption is optional, and the drill runs on the project's own CI, not on the deployer's hosting.
- **Support and continuity** — 10%. One maintainer and no service-level agreement ([`GOVERNANCE.md`](../../../GOVERNANCE.md)).
- **Translations** — 20%. Text in languages other than English is machine-written until a speaker reviews it, and statutory language duties need reviewed text ([language statement](../../../governance/language-statement.md)).
- **Clinical use** — 0%. No clinical safety case has been written, and clinical use is out of scope.

## What a first deployment should do

1. Complete the [assurance checklist](../../../governance/assurance-checklist.md), starting with a penetration test and an accessibility audit.
2. Fill every "Buyer to complete" row in the [DTAC checklist](../../../governance/dtac-checklist.md) and the markers in the [DPIA](../../../governance/dpia.md).
3. Agree retention periods with the records manager and schedule the purge.
4. Turn on encrypted backups and run the restore drill on the deployment's own hosting.
5. Keep the data non-clinical and below the marking level the deployment is assured for.
6. Plan for the gaps above, or fund their removal.

The evidence for each item is in the [assessment](../../../governance/production-readiness.md).
